ideas.title: Minnesota's Systematic Fraud Issues
ideas.description: Investigate the root causes and extent of Minnesota's fraud problem.
ideas.angle: Exploring the role of systematic failures in enabling fraud.
questions: What are the root causes of Minnesota's fraud issue?
How can systematic failures be addressed?
ideas.insight: The recent actions by the DOJ and state authorities indicate a significant and possibly widespread fraud issue in Minnesota. Investigating the systematic failures that enable such fraud could uncover deeper issues.

ideas.title: The Woodhill Capital Ponzi Scheme
ideas.description: Investigate the details of the Woodhill Capital Ponzi scheme.
ideas.angle: Examining the scope and impact of the alleged Ponzi scheme.
questions: How did the Ponzi scheme operate?
ideas.insight: The alleged Ponzi scheme involving Woodhill Capital with over $40M unaccounted for requires a detailed investigation to understand its scope and impact.
